column3: “One of the descendants of Media” is rendered “of Median descent.”
“Scrolls” is rendered “books,” and “ruins” “desolations”; NASB renders “which came the word of Yahweh” as “which was revealed as the word of the LORD” and adds “namely.”
“Set my face” is rendered “gave my attention”; NASB supplies “Him” after “seek.”
“I beg you” is rendered “Alas”; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
NASB adds “even.”
“Leaders” is rendered “princes,” and “ancestors” “fathers.”
“Shame of the faces” is rendered “open shame”; “everyone of Judah” is rendered “the men of Judah,” and “banished” “driven.”
“Shame of the faces” is rendered “Open shame”; NASB has “O Lord” for the Hebrew “O Yahweh.”
“Compassions and forgivenesses” (plurals) are rendered “compassion and forgiveness.”
“Listened to the voice” is rendered “obeyed the voice,” and “laws” “teachings.”
“Poured forth” is rendered “has been poured out”; NASB adds “along with.”
“Carried out his word” is rendered “confirmed His words,” and “judges who judged us” “rulers who ruled us.”
“Entreated the face” is rendered “sought the favor,” and “faithfulness” “truth.”
“Kept watch over the calamity” is rendered “kept the calamity in store.”
“Strong hand” is rendered “mighty hand.”
“Righteousnesses” is rendered “righteous acts,” and “mountain of your holiness” “Your holy mountain.”
“For the sake of the Lord” is rendered “for Your sake, O Lord.”
“Not on our righteousnesses” is rendered “not … on account of any merits of our own,” and “making fall” “presenting.”
“Be attentive” is rendered “listen,” and “act” “take action.”
“On the mountain” is rendered “in behalf of the holy mountain.”
“At the beginning” is rendered “previously”; “wearied with weariness” is rendered “in my extreme weariness,” applied to Daniel; the meaning is uncertain.
“Gave understanding” is rendered “gave me instruction.”
“A word went forth” is rendered “the command was issued”; “precious” is rendered “highly esteemed,” and NASB adds “so.”
“Sevens” is rendered “weeks”; “complete sin” is rendered “make an end of sin,” “prophet” “prophecy,” and “a holy place of holy places” “the most holy place.”

“Word” is rendered “decree”; “an anointed one, a prince” is rendered “Messiah the Prince,” and “sevens” “weeks.” NASB joins “seven weeks and sixty-two weeks” in one span; the Hebrew accents divide after “seven.”
“An anointed one” is rendered “the Messiah,” and “sevens” “weeks”; NASB renders “his end” as “its end.”

“Seven” is rendered “week,” and “offering” “grain offering.” NASB renders “desolating” as “one who makes desolate,” and the last “desolate” as “the one who makes desolate”; the meaning of the end of the verse is uncertain.
